title: Psalm 51 (Create in Me a Clean Heart)
lyrics_original: Create in me a clean heart, O God;
And renew a right spirit within me.
Create in me a clean heart, O God;
And renew a right spirit within me.
Cast me not away from Thy presence, O Lord
And take not Thy Holy Spirit from me.
Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation;
And renew a right spirit within me.

bible_verses.english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that Your mercy is always greater than my shortcomings. Create in me a clean heart today, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit deep within me. Forgive me where I have fallen short, and draw me closer to Your comforting presence. Restore to me the fresh joy of Your salvation, and help me walk daily in the freedom of Your love. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Psalm 51 is an honest, beautiful cry for spiritual renewal and restoration. We often try to fix our own mistakes, but only God can create a truly clean heart and renew a steadfast spirit within us. When we come to Him with open hands, He does not turn us away; instead, He restores the quiet joy of His salvation through Christ. As you sing today, lay down your burdens and allow His grace to refresh your soul from the inside out.
